Provides flexible adjustment of streamline geometry for visual continuity [S2, unofficial].

The evidence in Source [S2] explicitly describes a method to adjust the start and end points of a streamline based on `m_lineWidth`. It details two modes: one expanding from the midpoint (wing line) and another setting fixed bounds based on orientation. These adjustments directly modify the geometry of the streamline to account for its width, which supports the claim of providing 'flexible adjustment of streamline geometry'. While the specific phrase 'for visual continuity' is not explicitly in the text, the geometric adjustments described are the technical implementation of ensuring the streamline renders correctly (continuously) relative to its width and orientation, making the claim supported by the provided facts.
